mainEntity.name: Which F-Pace engines do you rebuild and repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on F-Pace 2.0 Ingenium diesel and petrol engines, the 3.0 V6 diesel and the SVR's supercharged 5.0 V8, following a full assessment.

mainEntity.name: How much is a Jaguar F-Pace engine replacement in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We give a quote after assessing your car instead of a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Is a rebuild better than a reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the damage. A rebuild suits contained faults, while a reconditioned engine may make more sense when damage is severe or widespread.

mainEntity.name: Do you have an F-Pace 306DT engine for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source and fit a reconditioned 306DT engine where replacement is the right option. Contact us with your registration to check availability.

mainEntity.name: Can a timing chain noise mean engine damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be a sign of wear, but noise alone does not confirm a fault. An inspection is needed to find the real cause.

mainEntity.name: How long will my F-Pace be off the road?

acceptedAnswer.text: That depends on the fault, parts availability and whether machining is required. We will give you an estimated timeframe after the initial assessment.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my F-Pace if I'm not nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our workshop is in Essex, and we offer collection and delivery across the UK, so distance does not need to be a barrier.
